title: SpecAndSecureChanged must fail closed on errors or missing old object
answers: Admission hook skip logic error handling for status patches
Why treat resolution errors as a spec change
body: Invariant: SpecAndSecureChanged must return true (treat as 'changed', so admission still runs) on any error extracting spec/secure via utils.MetaAccessor, or when a.GetOldObject() is nil. This is enforced inside SpecAndSecureChanged itself. If a future change made it fail open (return false on error), mutation/validation hooks would be silently skipped on uncertain input, letting unvalidated spec/secure changes through a subresource request. Any new admission hook that reuses this helper must call it in addition to, not instead of, the a.GetSubresource() != "" check.
applies: apps/provisioning/pkg/apis/admission/subresource.go and any admission hook reusing it

search: Admission hook SpecAndSecureChanged in apps/provisioning/pkg/apis/admission/subresource.go must return true (treat as changed) on any error extracting spec/secure or when a.GetOldObject() is nil, enforcing fail-closed behavior. If changed to return false on error, mutation and validation hooks would silently skip on uncertain input, allowing unvalidated spec/secure changes through subresource requests. Any new admission hook reusing this helper must call it in addition to, not instead of, the a.GetSubresource() != '' check. Applies when implementing admission hooks in provisioning APIs or extending existing subresource hooks.
